title: DPI-Watch: An Inhaler Sound Dataset
why_promising: Primary human respiratory/vocal-tract production recordings; 71 WAV recordings manually segmented by auditory inspection into actuation, exhalation, and inhalation, yielding 68 actuation, 123 exhalation, and 71 inhalation segments; public Zenodo ZIP with MD5 f65fd70d784f475fd4882f00ed0274fe.
open_question: Borderline scope: determine whether non-speech respiratory productions belong in the phonetic-production database; inspect ZIP for interval timestamps/labels and participant metadata before admission. Do not admit automatically.

title: Praditor manual speech-onset evaluation datasets
why_promising: Mandarin and English speech-onset evaluation uses manual onset annotations as gold standard against automatic detection; potentially useful isolated manually annotated production landmarks.
open_question: Locate authoritative public evaluation data in the GitHub repository; establish recording lineage and whether recordings are primary to the study rather than reused corpora. Admit only primary manually annotated landmarks.

title: Cross-lingual phonetic speech segmentation manual reference subset
why_promising: Study reports a 90-sentence (~12 minute) manually segmented reference set used to evaluate phonetic segmentation systems.
open_question: Identify underlying corpus/recording lineage and locate a public deposit containing the manual reference segmentation. Exclude if recordings are secondary and no isolatable newly created annotation layer is public.
